title: Arc footer
description: A white five-column footer: a bold lowercase wordmark, three columns of bold group headings over warm-grey links (a column can stack two groups), and a newsletter column with a hairline email field and a full-width filled button; then a hairline and a 12px legal row with copyright, links and social icons on the right. On phones the link columns pair up two by two. Links darken on hover.
notes: the newsletter form has no handler: wire its action up yourself
